title: Headcount per department
description: Return each department_id and the number of employees in it as employee_count.
expected_query: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees GROUP BY department_id;

title: Average salary per department
description: Return each department_id and the average salary of its employees as avg_salary.
expected_query: SELECT department_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY department_id;

title: Units sold per product
description: Using order_items, return each product_id and the total quantity ordered as total_quantity.
expected_query: SELECT product_id, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM order_items GROUP BY product_id;

title: Large departments
description: Return the department_id and employee_count (as in COUNT(*)) for departments with more than 3 employees.
expected_query: SELECT department_id, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM employees GROUP BY department_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3;
